title: DESIGN OF LARGE SCALE BRIDGES
description: Design of large-scale and complex bridges with emphasis on cable-supported structures. Static and dynamic loads, component design of towers, superstructures and cables; conceptual design of major bridge types including arches, cable stayed bridges and suspension bridges
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( CIEN E3121 ) and ( CIEN E3127 ) or CIEN E3121 AND CIEN E3127 ; or equivalent.
